verdicts.reason: A: the reading order is broken. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline and is set large enough to compete with it. The Blood Orange pill lands on the column of legal text on the left, and the other two pills are split above and below the Shop Flavours button, so the three flavour pills are scattered across both ends of the banner. B: the structure is sensible (headline on the left, CTA in the centre, flavour pills grouped top right) and the headline and CTA lead clearly. Its flaws: the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an almost invisible size above the button, the subhead is tiny and wraps awkwardly beside the pills, the legal line is jammed right under the button, and the right-hand cluster is cramped.
